scene_description: A "ROAD CLOSED" sign with a white background, black text, and black border is mounted on an orange A-frame stand in the middle of a flooded roadway. The water covers the asphalt, reaching up toward the eaves of a light-colored garage building on the left. Trees, some with hanging moss, are partially submerged in the floodwater. In the background, other structures and yellow traffic signs, including one that says "NO OUTLET," are visible across the flooded area under an overcast sky.<turn|>
editing_instruction: Add a high-water rescue boat with orange and yellow markings navigating through the floodwater near the garage building. Place two rescue personnel in bright neon-yellow dry suits and helmets on the boat, one holding a long-handled pole. Add a professional rescue team member standing on the dry ground near the garage, wearing a life vest and carrying a heavy-duty orange rescue bag. Position a large orange and white emergency response truck parked on a nearby elevated dry patch of land. Add a portable floodlight tower with a bright LED array near the garage. Ensure all added vehicles and personnel are scaled realistically to the buildings and trees. Maintain the overcast
